problems.phrase: When I flew on a long flight, the airline gave us blankets and pillows.
I had assumed that since it was a somewhat cheap blanket they were part of the ticket cost or something.
Is there a way I can return it to the airline?
Or should I just forget about it, having learned my lesson?
Just for reference, the airline in particular was Aer Lingus.

* * *

But if you have their explicit instructions to keep it then you won't have to worry about anything.
